operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1-101. The United States Civil Service Commission, in consultation with the Attorney General, the Secretary of Defense with respect to members of the armed forces, and the Mayor of the District of Columbia with respect to employees of the Government thereof, is authorized to promulgate regulations for the uniform implementation of Section 459 of the Social Security Act, as amended (42 U.S.C. 659), hereinafter referred to as the Act.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 1-101

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: 1-102. The regulations promulgated by the United States Civil Service Commission pursuant to this Order shall:

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 1-102 (lead-in)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (a) Be applicable to the Executive branch of the Government as defined in Section 461 (a) (1) of the Act (42 U.S.G. 661 (a)(1)).

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 1-102(a)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text:
(b) Require the appropriate officials of the Executive branch of the Government to take the actions prescribed by Sections 461(b) (1), 461(b)(3) (A) and 461
(c) of the Act (42 U.S.C. 661 (b) (1), 661(b) (3) (A) and 661(c)).

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 1-102(b)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (c) Require the appropriate officials of the Executive branch of the Government to issue such rules, regulations and directives as are necessary to implement the regulations of the United States Civil Service Commission.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 1-102(c)
